items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: Ben Pollack came in and we went up the coast... During that time, they brought a band from the East out by the name of Ben Pollack.

ctx.x: Do you remember what years? Did you

No, we only did that when we were out of Sebastian's Cotton Club and one of the other big bands came in to replace us, like in one of the years, I went into the band after McKinney's Cotton Pickers had come there, somewhere around 1930, to play. During that time, Les Height would be out doing extemporaneous jobs. All right, the next time we came out of there, another band came in, Ben Pollack came in and we went up the coast. That's the first time the band went all the way to Vancouver. We played every little…
Do you remember what years that was?
